timelineItems.title: Senior Software Engineer
timelineItems.description: Wipro Limited, Bangalore | Leading enterprise frontend architecture and team of 5 engineers.
details: Owned end-to-end frontend architecture for a large-scale customer-facing platform, driving decisions on UI structure, performance strategy, and long-term maintainability

Improved Time to Interactive (TTI) by 35% through change detection tuning and rendering paths optimization
Led production rollout and ensured smooth transition by resolving performance regressions and critical UI defects

Built the UI for a Sound Pressure Level (SPL) visualization platform used to map and optimize acoustics for a 125k-capacity venue
Partnered with QA and business stakeholders to define acceptance criteria for 4 different modules, achieving zero critical production defects across 3 consecutive releases
